queries.scope: Resolve the West Bengal city using the supplied WUP point and find official parcel-map services.
queries.result: The supplied point is in Kharagpur, Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal; it does not point to the separate Kharagpur locality in Bihar. West Bengal Banglarbhumi lists Mouza Map Availability and land-record services. The state urban Know Your Property workflow requires OTP registration and a specific district, block, mouza and plot/khatian selection. The WBIIDC cadastral sheet found is explicitly Kharagpur Industrial Park-only and does not establish whole-city coverage.

queries.result: Official West Bengal land-record services include plot map and mouza-map availability; the state urban property-record integration is OTP/login plus plot/khatian-specific. One official field-survey map covers Kharagpur Industrial Park only. No anonymous general-city full-polygon API was found.
